cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description: Be your own captain. Experience the sights and sounds of Mission Bay Park free of rattling engine noise while touring the famous beachside waterfront playground.

- Max of 10 passengers *including children* (not to exceed 1500 lbs.)

- Spacious, upholstered bench seating arrangement
- Full bimini top 
- Bluetooth stereo system
- Life vests included (all sizes)
